data.one_liner: An edited version of Expansion Tile that allows you customize tile widget and animation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable expansion tile widget with configurable animations, builders, and state saving capabilities. It allows developers to define custom title widgets and control the expansion state programmatically or automatically.
use_when: You need a customized expansion tile with bespoke animations and custom title layouts.
You want to automatically save and restore the expansion state of a tile.
avoid_when: The standard Material ExpansionTile meets all your design and animation requirements without modifications.
strengths: Customizable tile widget builder and animation parameters
Supports auto-saving and restoring expansion states
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic parameters and a single README example
